bibliographic.title: Lead Sarcophagus (in space)
bibliographic.author: Lin Lune
bibliographic.description:
Inspired by the real life story of the seed bank Bureau of Applied Botany in Russia, where amid a WW2 siege its seed keepers starved to death surrounded by heirloom peanuts and rice and food crops.

You play a water-based alien who does not care about the significance of human cultural artifacts. Lie, cheat, and bribe the human museum curator to basically burn their peat core climate data for heating.
